title: Project video settings and background descriptions
items: Set screenshot detail, transcription and sound effects for each project from Project Settings.
Maximum captures up to four screenshots per second. Larger screenshot sets stay on FUPCJ Server and download with your export.
The local visual worker can describe frames in the background, retain timestamped observations and resume interrupted analysis.
Activity is now a floating button in Vision and Venture, with progress, pause/resume and persistent error notices. Update FUPCJ Server to use the new video processing features.
